description: Address v1 review feedback: credential redaction, copy engine runtime trigger, group member field name fix, settings persistence, platform UI gating
steps: Create a credential redaction helper at src/lib/utils.ts and strip apiKey/apiSecret from GET account responses
Create POST /api/groups/[id]/webhook route to trigger trade copying through the copy engine
Create src/lib/trading/copy-service.ts wiring subscribeTrades to the copy engine
Fix accountId -> tradingAccountId in POST /api/groups and POST /api/groups/:id/members
Add UserPreferences model to Prisma schema and create GET/PUT /api/settings route
Wire settings page to save/load via API
Add Coming Soon badge on NinjaTrader/Rithmic in the create-account-dialog and handle gracefully in sync route
Update adapter-factory to return a clear error with platform name
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/accounts and GET /api/accounts/[id] do not return apiKey or apiSecret values
POST /api/groups/[id]/webhook accepts a trade signal and runs it through the copy engine
copy-service.ts provides a subscribeMasterAccount function connecting adapter to engine
Group creation uses tradingAccountId field correctly
Settings page persists and loads preferences from /api/settings
NinjaTrader and Rithmic show Coming Soon badge and are disabled in the create account dialog
findings: Build passes with only pre-existing unused variable warnings. All 124 tests pass (9 new tests for maskCredential and redactAccountCredentials). Prisma generate cannot run due to network restrictions on prisma.sh, so the UserPreferences model type was manually added to the generated Prisma client types. The existing Error during static page generation for /api/metrics route is pre-existing from FEAT-004. The /api/settings route also shows a similar harmless error during static gen since it uses getServerSession (which uses headers). Also fixed the tradingAccount relation name in GET /api/groups/[id] route (was using 'account' but Prisma schema defines 'tradingAccount').
